method: CAMS PM2.5 (Copernicus, via Open-Meteo), averaged over each local day, turned into PSI with NEA's PM2.5 breakpoints, then adjusted to this week's readings: scaled by the last 3 days' ratio of the measured index (NEA's PSI or DOE's API) to the model's own estimate on the same scale. An estimate from a computer model.
